a:t.name: comment
a:t.value: The modelinfo included with the published IG is using [derived modelinfo](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/using-modelinfo.html#derived-modelinfo) to enable reuse of data elements and libraries defined in the [US Core](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/core) and [US CQL](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/cql) Common IGs. This library is derived from the QICoreCommon shared library used in FHIR-based quality measure specifications. However, most of the functionality that was defined in QICoreCommon is now either in [FHIRCommon](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/Library-FHIRCommon.html) or [USCoreCommon](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/cql/Library-USCoreCommon.html).
